usage: 燒肉 is used as a noun to refer specifically to roast pork, especially crispy pork belly.
You can use 燒肉 as the subject or object in a sentence.
It often appears in food menus or when ordering at restaurants.
燒肉 can be combined with other words to describe dishes, like 燒肉飯 (roast pork rice).
When talking about food preferences, 燒肉 is commonly used to specify this particular pork dish.

examples.meaning: I want to eat roast pork tonight.
